propositions: The test's observed_upsert monkeypatch closure has a narrower signature than the real CriterionBank.upsert, lacking evidence_sufficient and seeded keyword-only parameters.
When verify_completion runs the bounded-fallback path (record_insufficient), production passes evidence_sufficient=False to upsert, causing the narrow stub to raise TypeError.
The TypeError surfaces only on the bedrock arm because anthropic/openai arms gathered sufficient evidence and never triggered the fallback path.
The fix forwards all kwargs (other than source) through the monkeypatch stub via **kwargs to preserve evidence_sufficient, seeded, and future upsert parameters.
A shared helper (make_observed_upsert in tests/_bank_observer.py) replaces the narrow closure in both live external tests and a new fast unit regression.
The unit regression (test_completion_bank_observer_forwarding.py) reproduces and validates the TypeError fix without live credentials.
